10.2.19 WdgMCrossClusterTransition
SWS Item
[ECUC_WdgM_00376]
Container Name
WdgMCrossClusterTransition
Parent Container
WdgMExternalLogicalSupervision
▽
△
Description
This container configures a cross cluster transition.
A WdgMCrossClusterTransition can be configured
• from a WdgMCheckpoint to a WdgMTransitionProxy
• from a WdgMTransitionProxy to a WdgMCheckpoint
• from a WdgMTransitionProxy to another WdgMTransitionProxy (in Host Software
Cluster only)
• from a WdgMTransitionProxy to the identical WdgMTransitionProxy (in Application
Software Cluster only for the case that no WdgMCheckpoint has to be reached in the
Application Software Cluster)
• from a WdgMCheckpoint to a WdgMCheckpoint (in case the cross cluster transition
graph is entirely described with WdgMCrossClusterTransition containers)

Description
